title: Find the elephant calf

scenes.label: a newborn calf's weight
scenes.body: Calves stand and nurse soon after birth.

scenes.headline: Raised in a family of females
scenes.body: Herds are related females, their daughters and young males.

scenes.headline: Bath time is skin-care time
scenes.body: At Pinnawala orphanage. Elephants also coat their skin in mud and dirt against sun and insects.

caption:
Every herd has a toddler hiding under it somewhere.

Asian elephants are endangered; an estimated 37,000–57,000 remain in the wild.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Asian elephant. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Hide-and-seek hook ('find the calf') makes viewers scan the frame; the bath clip is honestly labelled as an orphanage. HIGH-RISK format: cute compilations are only OK with our own footage.
